newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania signed a framework deal on financial cooperation with the European Investment Bank.
* Romania is holding ceremonies to honour the memory of its heroes, on the day of Orthodox Ascension.
* Parliament's lower Chamber of Deputies passed a bill on land leasing. The bill stipulates that only Romanian citizens can lease land and that the minimum lease should be five years.
* The lower house also passed a law on human organs transplantation. The law allows healthy adults to give organs for transplants provided that their life is not at risk by the donation.

* Trade unions in public services marched through central Bucharest to protest against the government's policy to liquidate many bankrupt companies instead of offering them for privatisation or restructuring them.
* Bucharest's Parliament Palace is hosting a conference on non-governmental organisations in Romania.
